title: Re-adjudication of the X2 'no incremental information over B/P' basis of RETIRE_RIM_PUBLIC_PRODUCT
authority: Owner directive 2026-08-07 (web ChatGPT master prompt 'FENO RIM RECOVERY'). Existing FINAL_RIM_DECISION.json RETIRE_RIM_PUBLIC_PRODUCT is preserved as history, not final authority. Public surface stays KEEP_QUARANTINED throughout.
independent_red_team: cc (Claude Code, left pane) — reviews criteria and re-computes key statistics with its own code; does not co-author implementation
frozen_at_note: This file and its receipt commit BEFORE any R0 result exists. Result paths listed in the receipt must not exist at freeze time.
model_change: NONE. R0 re-uses the X2 pipeline verbatim (same V/P construction, same B/P, same returns, same member filters, same origin sets). R0 only adds statistics on top of the identical firm-level rows, plus two pre-registered control variables (size, momentum) for R0-C Model 2.

data_contract.origin_sets: All 34 origins and the 18 window-complete origins exactly as X2 derived them: window-complete = E1_E2_FORENSIC_AUDIT.json p0_adjudications.p0_3_baseline_truncation.evidence.e2_baseline_windows.window_rows_per_origin filtered years>=9.5.
data_contract.member_eligibility: Identical to x2-cross-sectional.mjs loop: m.ok && m.book>0 && m.price>0 && m.shares>0 && Number.isFinite(m.roe); price series exists; both endpoint prices within 45 calendar days of t0/t1; V finite and >0; per-origin n>=20.
data_contract.vp_construction: Verbatim x2-cross-sectional.mjs: deployPath(H=3, FADE=3, target=roe_band midpoint) then riValue(book0, path, ke) with TERM=10 linear decay. ke = DGS10(as_of)*0.01 + last ERP observation with first_knowable<=t0.
data_contract.return_construction: 36-month annualized total return tr = ((p1+div)/p0)^(1/3) - 1, dividends strictly inside (t0, t1], unadjusted prices.
data_contract.reproduction_gate: Before any new statistic is reported, the re-derived firm-level pipeline MUST reproduce every ic_vp and ic_bp in RIM_CROSS_SECTIONAL_BOTTOM_UP.json per_origin_rows within 1e-6 and the same n and complete flags. Any mismatch aborts R0.

common_statistics_contract.rank_function: Same average-tie rank function as x2-cross-sectional.mjs, applied within each origin.
common_statistics_contract.unit_ranks_for_regressions: u = (rank-1)/(n-1) in [0,1]; slope units = annualized return spread from u=0 to u=1.
common_statistics_contract.excess_return: exc = tr - rf0 where rf0 = DGS10(as_of)*0.01 (annual rate at origin). Note: per-origin location shift; cross-sectional slopes are invariant, only intercepts move. Primary dependent variable = exc.
common_statistics_contract.bootstrap: Moving-block bootstrap on origin-level series; reps=10000; block lengths {4,8,12}; block-4 is primary; LCG seed 20260807 (same generator as x2 boot()).
common_statistics_contract.newey_west: HAC on origin-level series, Bartlett kernel, lag = max(2, floor(4*(T/100)^(2/9))) which evaluates to lag=2 for T=18 and T=34. Two-sided p from t distribution approximated by normal (report both t-stat and p).
common_statistics_contract.seeds: All bootstrap/permutation RNG seeded deterministically; permutation seed = 20260807 + origin_index. No result-dependent re-seeding permitted.

r0a_paired_ic_difference.definition: D_t = IC_t(V/P) - IC_t(B/P), Spearman, identical member set per origin (the X2 loop).
r0a_paired_ic_difference.instability_rule: If the sign of the conclusion (positive vs non-positive) differs across block lengths {4,8,12} within either set, flag INCREMENTAL_DIFFERENCE_UNSTABLE and R0-A is recorded as inconclusive regardless of point estimates.

r0b_residualized_vp.definition: Per origin OLS: rank(V/P)_i = a + b*rank(B/P)_i + resid_i (raw average-tie ranks). IC_t(resid, ret) via the same Spearman sp().
r0b_residualized_vp.interpretation_precommitted: Positive residual IC with CI excluding zero means V/P carries return information not contained in B/P, even when the raw IC difference is negative.

r0c_fama_macbeth.model1: exc_i = a_t + b1_t*u(B/P)_i + b2_t*u(V/P)_i + e_i  (per origin OLS, unit ranks)
r0c_fama_macbeth.model2: exc_i = a_t + b1_t*u(B/P)_i + b2_t*u(V/P)_i + b3_t*u(Size)_i + b4_t*u(Mom)_i + e_i
r0c_fama_macbeth.primary: Model 1. Model 2 is sensitivity only (small samples).
r0c_fama_macbeth.size: u(log(mc)) with mc = member market cap at origin.
r0c_fama_macbeth.momentum: Mom = c[i0-21]/c[i0-252] - 1 on unadjusted closes; i0 = last observation on/before t0 (same 45-day tolerance as X2); require i0>=252. Members without momentum are EXCLUDED from Model 2 only; Model 1 member set is never altered. If a origin's Model-2 n < 20, that origin's Model 2 is voided and reported.
report: leave-one-out: max |delta mean| and any sign flip

r0d_stratified_permutation.design: Per origin: split members into B/P terciles by rank(B/P) group = floor(3*(rank-1)/n). Within each tercile, median-split by rank(V/P) into high/low halves (odd counts: low gets the extra member). Statistic S = unweighted mean over the 3 terciles of (mean_ret(high) - mean_ret(low)), computed on exc.
r0d_stratified_permutation.permutation: Shuffle V/P labels within each B/P tercile, recompute S, reps=10000 per origin, one-sided p for S_obs>0 and two-sided p.
report: share origins with one-sided p<0.05 and S>0
r0d_stratified_permutation.note: Small-sample implementation of the Frankel-Lee bi-dimensional logic; 5x5 sorts are too sparse at n~25.

verdict_mapping.R0_INCREMENTAL_POSITIVE: ALL of: (1) R0-C Model1 mean b2 > 0 AND NW p <= 0.05 AND block-4 bootstrap CI lower > 0 on window_complete; (2) same-sign mean b2 > 0 on all_origins; (3) R0-B mean residual IC > 0 AND block-4 CI lower > 0 on window_complete. Robustness flag set only if blocks 8 and 12 CIs also exclude zero on the positive side in both (1) and (3); otherwise verdict carries unstable_block_sensitivity.
verdict_mapping.R0_INCREMENTAL_NEGATIVE: Mirror image of POSITIVE with all inequalities reversed.
verdict_mapping.R0_INCREMENTAL_ZERO: Equivalence: R0-C Model1 b2 95% block-4 CI inside [-0.01,+0.01] AND R0-B residual IC block-4 CI inside [-0.05,+0.05] AND R0-A mean D block-4 CI inside [-0.05,+0.05], each on BOTH sets.
verdict_mapping.R0_INCONCLUSIVE: Anything else, including any INCREMENTAL_DIFFERENCE_UNSTABLE flag from block-length sensitivity.
verdict_mapping.hierarchy: Controlled tests (R0-B, R0-C) decide the verdict; raw paired difference (R0-A) and permutation (R0-D) are corroboration. A negative R0-A with positive controlled verdict is the Frankel-Lee pattern, not a contradiction.

prohibitions: No change to V/P, B/P, return, or member-filter construction.
No threshold, seed, lag, band, or set definition may change after results are observed.
No overwriting FINAL_RIM_DECISION.json or any prior audit artifact; new adjudication goes to R0_ADJUDICATION.json.
No public number republication; quarantine untouched.
